question: Who edited the anthology titled Bihu: The Agricultural Festival of Assam?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Sanjib Kr Borkakoti**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• New Book Highlights Assam’s Bihu Festival for UNESCO Recognition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Efforts are underway to get **Bihu** listed in **UNESCO’s intangible cultural heritage**.

 
 
• 
 
A new book titled **Bihu: The Agricultural Festival of Assam** explores all aspects of **Bihu**.

 
 
• 
 
Edited by **Sanjib Kr Borkakoti**, the anthology studies the **festival in its entirety**.

 
 
• 
 
**ICOMOS Northeast India** has been organizing programs to promote **Bihu globally**.
